message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo was one of the bloodiest single engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  In total, roughly **45,000 soldiers** were killed, wounded, or taken prisoner:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| Allied (British, Dutch‑German, Prussian) | ~25,000 |
| French | ~20,000 |

These figures are based on contemporary reports and modern historical estimates; exact numbers vary slightly among sources, but the consensus places the total at around forty‑five thousand.
